summary: No change: submission.json holds only the rationale, adding no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment; the bytes validate with no diagnostics. All questions opened in this run are already recorded as explained (a retained receipt for each measured answer, an explicit source-only basis for the lease-read answer), no necessary gap is open, every execution carries its interpretation, and the findings with counterevidence plus the sourced mechanism entries stand on the record. Because the budget expires in this turn, a further experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it evidence and more sourced entries would repeat recorded code, so the update stays unchanged; expiry preserves the retained work and needs no closing call, with defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication left to human offline review.
